production.order: Generate v00 first and check each of the six family members and the dog is clearly different and fully visible; every later photo is an edit of v00 and keeps one or two of them. Check each photo shows only its own sentence: one lamp on in v02 and none elsewhere, one cup in v08, no cups on v06's table, no ball in v04.

shared_prompts.photo: Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material texture and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Every visible hand has five natural fingers. Do not imitate earlier course photos. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere, not on signs, menus, screens, cups, clothes or bags.
shared_prompts.safe_center: Keep the people and the thing that carries the meaning inside the central 55 percent of the photo width, so a centered 4:5 crop keeps them whole; only expendable background reaches the left and right edges.
shared_prompts.solo: Only this one person is in the photo; there is nobody else, even far in the background.
shared_prompts.pair: Only these two people are in the photo; there is nobody else, even far in the background.
shared_prompts.daytime: It is clearly daytime with soft natural light.
shared_prompts.nobody: There are no people and no animals anywhere in the photo.
shared_prompts.evening: It is evening: the window shows a dark blue sky.
shared_prompts.nolamp: No lamp or light is switched on anywhere in the photo.

assets.item: Reference only: the review's fresh family.
assets.prompt: Create a photograph of a real, warm family of six standing together on the front lawn of their two-story house, all smiling at the camera, in a row from left to right in this order.  The family: a GRANDFATHER of about 75 with short white hair, thin round glasses and a navy cardigan over a white shirt; a GRANDMOTHER of about 72 with short grey curly hair and a red cardigan; a FATHER of about 45 with short black hair and a short black beard, in a light-blue shirt; a MOTHER of about 42 with long straight brown hair, in a green blouse; a GIRL of about twelve with two long dark braids, in a yellow T-shirt; a BOY of about nine with short brown hair, in an orange T-shirt; and their dog, a medium black-and-white dog with floppy ears. The dog sits on the grass in front of them. Every face is clearly visible.

assets.item: The grandfather is upstairs. / Where's the grandfather? He's upstairs.
assets.prompt: Image 1 shows the family. Keep the GRANDFATHER exactly as in Image 1: face, hair, age and clothes. Create a new photograph inside their bright two-story house. The camera stands downstairs in the front hallway and looks at a straight wooden staircase that rises to an open upstairs landing with a white wooden banister; the whole staircase, the hallway floor at its foot and the landing are clearly visible. The grandfather stands UPSTAIRS on the landing at the top of the stairs, one hand on the banister, and smiles down toward the camera; his whole body is visible up on the landing. The stairs and the downstairs hallway are empty.

assets.item: She turns on the lamp. / The lamp is on.

The lamp is ON: it glows brightly and lights her notebook and her face. The lamp, its glow and her hand on the switch are large and clearly visible.

assets.item: The dog is behind the chair.
